messages.content: Predict the recorded human choice in an anonymous trust game. Payoffs are in Japanese yen. The investor starts with500 yen. If the investor keeps it, investor and receiver each earn500. If the investor trusts, that endowment is replaced by2V yen for the receiver, who may reciprocate (V each) or defect (investor0,receiver2V). Do not add the500 to these outcomes. Participants are randomly matched anonymously. No choice outcomes are revealed until the experiment ends. One randomly selected trial determines payment. Output only sure (keep) or risky (trust).
Role: investor. V=900 yen. Age: 19 years. Recorded sex: man. Before deciding you rated likelihood of reciprocation 2 on the1–8 scale (1=very unlikely,8=very likely).
